name: same-pinch
description: Convenience scripts only. frontend/, backend/ and shared/ are independent packages, each with its own install.

scripts.setup: npm i && npm i --prefix shared && npm i --prefix backend && npm i --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "wait-on -t 60000 tcp:127.0.0.1:3000 && npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix shared && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix shared && npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix shared && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix shared && npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
